name: Queue Reshuffle
subtitle: Move and rewrite scheduled posts by just asking.
summary: Reads your scheduled queue and moves or rewrites posts conversationally ("push the 9am to tomorrow", "make Thursday's punchier"). Every change is an approval card; nothing moves without you.
provide: which post and what to change.
get: current vs proposed on a card, one card per change.
launchPrompt: Show my scheduled posts and flag any that should move to a better time or need a punchier hook, then propose the changes.
